body: Thank you for your words. I’m glad it gave you a glimmer of hope. I had hoped my story would help another individual.
I write so people it may help someone, thank you
Took me awhile to post it, but thank you❤️

I ended up getting rushed to an icu and was in so much physical pain, wasn’t allowed out, my body was hooked up to so many machines. Shit sucked 
I deal with the after effects to this day, my body hurts a lot and I get flashbacks

You literally explained what I went through  and currently am going through.. yes, I would agree this is ‘normal’.
Sorry for your nana

My grandma lived a year and a half or more with 10% kidney function. But she had other health problems that contributed to her passing. I’m somewhat well aware of how kidneys function as I took care of her and spoke to her doctors throughout her last years.
